oe_ely_set_mode_immediate_1337 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_off }
		remove_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_off
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_exile_only }
		remove_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_exile_only
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_ely_mode_immediate_1337 value = 1 }
}

oe_ely_set_mode_off = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_ely_mode_off value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_immediate_1337 }
		remove_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_immediate_1337
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_exile_only }
		remove_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_exile_only
	}
}

oe_ely_set_mode_exile_only = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_off }
		remove_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_off
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_immediate_1337 }
		remove_global_variable = oe_ely_mode_immediate_1337
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_ely_mode_exile_only value = 1 }
}

}

# Country scope. Dev Panel fast-forward: initialize voyage if needed and jump straight to oe_ely.13.
oe_ely_dev_instant_landfall = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_voyager } }
		oe_ely_init_voyage = yes
	}
	oe_ely_discover_western_med_and_macaronesia = yes
	oe_ely_discover_mid_atlantic = yes
	oe_ely_discover_chesapeake_coast = yes
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_voyage_stage value = 5 }
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.13
}

# Country scope. Begin Act I: Project Ark & oe_sit_fourth_odyssey.
oe_ely_init_voyage = {
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_voyager value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_voyage_stage value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_fleet_morale value = 70 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_provisions value = 75 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_relic_score value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ark_tier value = 2 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_old_world_code value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_old_world_ceded_n value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_last_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_ely_declined }
		remove_variable = oe_ely_declined
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_aborted }
		remove_global_variable = oe_ely_aborted
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_ely_odyssey_launched value = 1 }
}

# Country scope. Safely adjust fleet morale (clamped 0..100).
oe_ely_add_morale = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_fleet_morale } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_ely_fleet_morale value = 70 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = oe_ely_fleet_morale add = $amount$ }
	if = {
		limit = { var:oe_ely_fleet_morale > 100 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_ely_fleet_morale value = 100 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:oe_ely_fleet_morale < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_ely_fleet_morale value = 0 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Safely adjust fleet provisions (clamped 0..100).

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:oe_ely_provisions < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_ely_provisions value = 0 }
	}
}

		set_variable = { name = oe_ely_relic_score value = 1 }

	}
}

# Country scope. Safely abort the voyage (only used on immediate_1337 turn-back).
oe_ely_abort_voyage = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_ely_voyager }
		remove_variable = oe_ely_voyager
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ely_exodus_fleet_mod }
		remove_country_modifier = oe_ely_exodus_fleet_mod
	}
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_voyage_stage value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_ely_aborted value = 1 }
}

oe_ely_discover_mid_atlantic = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_chart_host
	discover_area = area:atlantic_sea_area
	discover_area = area:atlantic_north_atlantic_current_area
	discover_area = area:atlantic_north_equatorial_area
	discover_area = area:atlantic_gulf_stream_area
	discover_area = area:bermuda_area
	area:bermuda_area = {
		every_location_in_area = {
			discover_location = scope:oe_ely_chart_host
		}
	}
	location:bermuda = {
		discover_location = scope:oe_ely_chart_host
	}
}

# Country scope. Claim uninhabited Bermuda as Cape Agios Nikolaos beacon outpost (oe_ely.10 Option A).
oe_ely_claim_bermuda_outpost = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_host
	location:bermuda = {
		discover_location = scope:oe_ely_host
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_ownable = yes
				has_owner = no
			}
			change_location_owner = scope:oe_ely_host
			add_core = scope:oe_ely_host
			rename_location = oe_loc_agios_nikolaos
			if = {
				limit = { scope:oe_ely_host = { exists = religion } }
				add_pop = {
					culture = culture:greek_culture
					religion = scope:oe_ely_host.religion
					type = pop_type:soldiers
					size = 0.15
				}
				add_pop = {
					culture = culture:greek_culture
					religion = scope:oe_ely_host.religion
					type = pop_type:burghers
					size = 0.10
				}
			}
			else = {
				add_pop = {
					culture = culture:greek_culture
					religion = religion:orthodox
					type = pop_type:soldiers
					size = 0.15
				}
				add_pop = {
					culture = culture:greek_culture
					religion = religion:orthodox
					type = pop_type:burghers
					size = 0.10
				}
			}
			add_location_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_ely_bermuda_beacon_mod
				years = -1
				mode = replace
			}
		}
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_ely_bermuda_beacon value = 1 }
}

# ==============================================================================
# Old World Evacuation, Chesapeake Pop Seeding & Atomic Safe Exodus (oe_ely.13)
# ==============================================================================

# Country scope. Deduct departing Greek emigrants from Old World cities before handover.
oe_ely_deduct_old_world_pops = {
	every_owned_location = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { continent = continent:america }
			NOT = { area = area:bermuda_area }
		}
		every_pop = {
			limit = {
				culture = culture:greek_culture
				pop_size > 0.40
			}
			add_pop_size = { value = -0.15 }
		}
	}
}

# Location scope helper: seed 6-estate Greek pops incl. laborers for lumber_mill / granary (expects scope:oe_ely_host).
oe_ely_seed_loc_5_estates = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:oe_ely_host = { exists = religion } }
		add_pop = { culture = culture:greek_culture religion = scope:oe_ely_host.religion type = pop_type:nobles size = $nob$ }
		add_pop = { culture = culture:greek_culture religion = scope:oe_ely_host.religion type = pop_type:clergy size = $clg$ }
		add_pop = { culture = culture:greek_culture religion = scope:oe_ely_host.religion type = pop_type:burghers size = $brg$ }
		add_pop = { culture = culture:greek_culture religion = scope:oe_ely_host.religion type = pop_type:soldiers size = $sld$ }
		add_pop = { culture = culture:greek_culture religion = scope:oe_ely_host.religion type = pop_type:laborers size = $lab$ }
		add_pop = { culture = culture:greek_culture religion = scope:oe_ely_host.religion type = pop_type:peasants size = $psn$ }
	}
	else = {
		add_pop = { culture = culture:greek_culture religion = religion:orthodox type = pop_type:nobles size = $nob$ }
		add_pop = { culture = culture:greek_culture religion = religion:orthodox type = pop_type:clergy size = $clg$ }
		add_pop = { culture = culture:greek_culture religion = religion:orthodox type = pop_type:burghers size = $brg$ }
		add_pop = { culture = culture:greek_culture religion = religion:orthodox type = pop_type:soldiers size = $sld$ }
		add_pop = { culture = culture:greek_culture religion = religion:orthodox type = pop_type:laborers size = $lab$ }
		add_pop = { culture = culture:greek_culture religion = religion:orthodox type = pop_type:peasants size = $psn$ }
	}
}

# Country scope. Seed Greek 6-estate refugee pops across Chesapeake bridgehead scaled by oe_ely_ark_tier (12k / 20k / 30k).
oe_ely_seed_chesapeake_pops = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_host
	if = {
		limit = { var:oe_ely_ark_tier ?= 3 }
		# Tier 3 (~30.0k total: chesapeake 15.0k, nansemond 8.0k, kiskiack 7.0k)
		location:chesapeake = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_ely_host }
				oe_ely_seed_loc_5_estates = { nob = 0.70 clg = 0.70 brg = 3.20 sld = 1.60 lab = 3.20 psn = 5.60 }
			}
		}
		location:nansemond = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_ely_host }
				oe_ely_seed_loc_5_estates = { nob = 0.30 clg = 0.30 brg = 1.50 sld = 0.90 lab = 1.80 psn = 3.20 }
			}
		}
		location:kiskiack = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_ely_host }
				oe_ely_seed_loc_5_estates = { nob = 0.25 clg = 0.25 brg = 1.20 sld = 0.80 lab = 1.70 psn = 2.80 }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:oe_ely_ark_tier ?= 1 }
		# Tier 1 (~12.0k total: chesapeake 6.0k, nansemond 3.2k, kiskiack 2.8k)
		location:chesapeake = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_ely_host }
				oe_ely_seed_loc_5_estates = { nob = 0.30 clg = 0.30 brg = 1.30 sld = 0.70 lab = 1.30 psn = 2.10 }
			}
		}
		location:nansemond = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_ely_host }
				oe_ely_seed_loc_5_estates = { nob = 0.14 clg = 0.14 brg = 0.62 sld = 0.40 lab = 0.70 psn = 1.20 }
			}
		}
		location:kiskiack = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_ely_host }
				oe_ely_seed_loc_5_estates = { nob = 0.12 clg = 0.12 brg = 0.50 sld = 0.36 lab = 0.65 psn = 1.05 }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		# Tier 2 (~20.0k total: chesapeake 10.0k, nansemond 5.5k, kiskiack 4.5k)
		location:chesapeake = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_ely_host }
				oe_ely_seed_loc_5_estates = { nob = 0.50 clg = 0.50 brg = 2.20 sld = 1.10 lab = 2.10 psn = 3.60 }
			}
		}
		location:nansemond = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_ely_host }
				oe_ely_seed_loc_5_estates = { nob = 0.22 clg = 0.22 brg = 1.06 sld = 0.60 lab = 1.20 psn = 2.20 }
			}
		}
		location:kiskiack = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_ely_host }
				oe_ely_seed_loc_5_estates = { nob = 0.18 clg = 0.18 brg = 0.84 sld = 0.50 lab = 1.05 psn = 1.75 }
			}
		}
	}
	# Bonus scholars, artisans & Varangian veterans if imperial relics were preserved (relic_score >= 3)
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = oe_ely_relic_score
			var:oe_ely_relic_score >= 3
			exists = capital
		}
		capital = {
			oe_ely_seed_loc_5_estates = { nob = 0.15 clg = 0.25 brg = 0.55 sld = 0.35 lab = 0.35 psn = 0.35 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Cleanly disband all Old World armies & navies stranded outside America/Bermuda,
# stop obsolete Old World cabinet missions, clear Old World loans, and stop Phoenix bandit spawns.
oe_ely_cleanup_old_world_units = {
	every_unit = {
		limit = {
			exists = unit_location
			unit_location = {
				NOT = { continent = continent:america }
				NOT = { area = area:bermuda_area }
			}
		}
		destroy_unit = yes
	}
	every_cabinet = {
		stop_cabinet_action = {}
	}
	pay_off_loans = { fraction = 1 }
	oe_phoenix_auto_bandit_stop = yes
}

# Country scope. Spawn an affordable Nova Elysia Founding Fleet & Imperial Guard right in the American capital.
# Gated on oe_ely_forces_spawned (NOT navy_size/army_size, because destroy_unit processes deferred).
oe_ely_spawn_founding_forces = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_forces_spawned }
			exists = capital
			capital = {
				continent = continent:america
				has_owner = yes
				is_port = yes
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_ely_forces_spawned value = 1 }
		capital = {
			create_num_sub_unit_of_category = {
				count = 3
				category = sub_unit_category:navy_transport
			}
			create_num_sub_unit_of_category = {
				count = 2
				category = sub_unit_category:navy_galley
			}
			create_num_sub_unit_of_category = {
				count = 2
				category = sub_unit_category:army_light_infantry
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Bootstrap Age 1 Chesapeake capital & bridgehead buildings + food reserve so the new market works on Day 1.
oe_ely_build_founding_infra = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_host
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			capital = {
				continent = continent:america
				has_owner = yes
				owner = scope:oe_ely_host
			}
		}
		capital = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_port = yes NOT = { has_building = building_type:dock } }
				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:dock cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "oe_ely_founding_infra_reason" instant = yes }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { raw_material = goods:lumber } NOT = { has_building = building_type:lumber_mill } }
				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:lumber_mill cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "oe_ely_founding_infra_reason" instant = yes }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:tools_guild } }
				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:tools_guild cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "oe_ely_founding_infra_reason" instant = yes }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:marketplace } }
				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:marketplace cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "oe_ely_founding_infra_reason" instant = yes }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_market_center = yes NOT = { has_building = building_type:market_warehouse } }
				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:market_warehouse cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "oe_ely_founding_infra_reason" instant = yes }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:granary } }
				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:granary cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "oe_ely_founding_infra_reason" instant = yes }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_food_seeded } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_ely_food_seeded value = 1 }
			capital.province = {
				change_province_food = 500
			}
		}
	}
	location:nansemond = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = scope:oe_ely_host
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_fish_rgo_boosted }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_ely_fish_rgo_boosted value = 1 }
			change_max_raw_material_workers = 2
		}
	}
	every_owned_location = {
		limit = {
			continent = continent:america
			location_rank = location_rank:rural_settlement
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					vegetation = woods
					vegetation = forest
					vegetation = farmland
					vegetation = jungle
				}
				NOT = { raw_material = goods:lumber }
				NOT = { has_building = building_type:lumber_mill }
			}
			construct_building = { building_type = building_type:lumber_mill cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "oe_ely_founding_infra_reason" instant = yes }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = { is_coastal = yes has_river = yes }
				NOT = { has_building = building_type:fishing_village }
			}
			construct_building = { building_type = building_type:fishing_village cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "oe_ely_founding_infra_reason" instant = yes }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Grant founding treasury, stability, manpower, sailors & 35-year Colonization/Assimilation/Economy buff.
oe_ely_grant_founding_package = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:oe_ely_ark_tier ?= 3 }
		add_gold = 700
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:oe_ely_ark_tier ?= 1 }
		add_gold = 350
	}
	else = {
		add_gold = 500
	}
	if = {
		limit = { stability < 25 }
		add_stability = 25
	}
	add_yearly_manpower = 2
	add_yearly_sailors = 2
	add_country_modifier = {
		modifier = oe_ely_nova_elysia_founded_mod
		years = 35
		mode = replace
	}
}

# Country scope. One-time automatic save-healing catch-up for existing pre-hotfix Nova Elysia saves.
oe_ely_apply_landfall_v2_catchup = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_host
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_landfall_v2_done value = 1 }
	oe_ely_discover_mid_atlantic = yes
	oe_ely_discover_chesapeake_coast = yes
	oe_ely_cleanup_old_world_units = yes
	oe_ely_spawn_founding_forces = yes
	oe_ely_build_founding_infra = yes
	# Top up missing refugee pops (incl. laborers) if this save landed before the v11.8.1 pop scale fix.
	location:chesapeake = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_ely_host }
			oe_ely_seed_loc_5_estates = { nob = 0.34 clg = 0.34 brg = 1.60 sld = 0.72 lab = 1.90 psn = 3.10 }
		}
	}
	location:nansemond = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_ely_host }
			oe_ely_seed_loc_5_estates = { nob = 0.14 clg = 0.14 brg = 0.72 sld = 0.40 lab = 1.05 psn = 1.85 }
		}
	}
	location:kiskiack = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_ely_host }
			oe_ely_seed_loc_5_estates = { nob = 0.12 clg = 0.12 brg = 0.60 sld = 0.34 lab = 0.92 psn = 1.50 }
		}
	}
	oe_ely_grant_founding_package = yes
}

# Country scope. Safely detach Old World holdings AFTER capital is verified in America.
# Priority: transfer to TUR (in Balkans/Anatolia) or AI neighbor; abandon_location strictly as fallback.
oe_ely_abandon_old_world = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_host
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_old_world_ceded_n value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			capital = { continent = continent:america }
			any_owned_location = { continent = continent:america }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_ely_old_world_code value = 1 }
		# 1. Sever Old World subjects cleanly so no phantom cross-ocean wars drag Nova Elysia back.
		every_subject = {
			limit = {
				exists = capital
				NOT = { capital = { continent = continent:america } }
			}
			save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_old_sub
			scope:oe_ely_host = {
				cancel_subject = scope:oe_ely_old_sub
			}
		}
		# 2. End active Old World wars cleanly and establish 15-year mutual truce with TUR.
		every_current_war = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						attacker_leader = scope:oe_ely_host
						defender_leader = scope:oe_ely_host
					}
				}
				white_peace = this
			}
			else = {
				save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_w
				scope:oe_ely_host = {
					leave_war = {
						war = scope:oe_ely_w
						actor = scope:oe_ely_host
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = c:TUR
				NOT = { tag = TUR }
			}
			add_truce_with = {
				target = c:TUR
				years = 15
				mutual = yes
			}
		}
		# 3. Transfer Old World locations (preserving America and Bermuda Cape Agios Nikolaos!).
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { continent = continent:america }
				NOT = { area = area:bermuda_area }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:oe_ely_host = {
						num_locations > 1
						exists = capital
						capital = { continent = continent:america }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						country_exists = c:TUR
						c:TUR = { is_ai = yes }
						OR = {
							region = region:balkan_region
							region = region:anatolia_region
						}
					}
					change_location_owner = c:TUR
					scope:oe_ely_host = { change_variable = { name = oe_ely_old_world_ceded_n add = 1 } }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						any_neighbor_location = {
							has_owner = yes
							owner = {
								is_ai = yes
								country_type = location
								NOT = { this = scope:oe_ely_host }
							}
						}
					}
					random_neighbor_location = {
						limit = {
							has_owner = yes
							owner = {
								is_ai = yes
								country_type = location
								NOT = { this = scope:oe_ely_host }
							}
						}
						owner = { save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_heir }
					}
					if = {
						limit = { exists = scope:oe_ely_heir }
						change_location_owner = scope:oe_ely_heir
						scope:oe_ely_host = { change_variable = { name = oe_ely_old_world_ceded_n add = 1 } }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						country_exists = c:TUR
						c:TUR = { is_ai = yes }
					}
					change_location_owner = c:TUR
					scope:oe_ely_host = { change_variable = { name = oe_ely_old_world_ceded_n add = 1 } }
				}
				else = {
					# Strict fallback: only abandon isolated Old World enclaves when capital is already in America.
					scope:oe_ely_host = {
						abandon_location = prev
						change_variable = { name = oe_ely_old_world_ceded_n add = 1 }
						set_variable = { name = oe_ely_old_world_code value = 2 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_owned_location = {
					NOT = { continent = continent:america }
					NOT = { area = area:bermuda_area }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_ely_old_world_code value = 3 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_ely_old_world_code value = 3 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Fallback in-place Safe Exodus sequence (only used if no Old-World-blind American seed exists).
oe_ely_complete_landfall_in_place = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_host
	# 1. Reveal Chesapeake & East Coast waters.
	oe_ely_discover_chesapeake_coast = yes
	# 2. Draw departing emigrants from Old World cities before handover.
	oe_ely_deduct_old_world_pops = yes
	# 3. Claim 3-location Chesapeake bridgehead (chesapeake, nansemond, kiskiack) & rename.
	location:chesapeake = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_ownable = yes
				OR = {
					has_owner = no
					AND = {
						has_owner = yes
						owner = { is_ai = yes }
					}
				}
			}
			change_location_owner = scope:oe_ely_host
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_ely_host }
			add_core = scope:oe_ely_host
			change_integration_level = core
			rename_location = oe_loc_nea_konstantinoupolis
		}
	}
	location:nansemond = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_ownable = yes
				OR = {
					has_owner = no
					AND = {
						has_owner = yes
						owner = { is_ai = yes }
					}
				}
			}
			change_location_owner = scope:oe_ely_host
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_ely_host }
			add_core = scope:oe_ely_host
			change_integration_level = core
			rename_location = oe_loc_chrysokeras_hesperias
		}
	}
	location:kiskiack = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_ownable = yes
				OR = {
					has_owner = no
					AND = {
						has_owner = yes
						owner = { is_ai = yes }
					}
				}
			}
			change_location_owner = scope:oe_ely_host
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_ely_host }
			add_core = scope:oe_ely_host
			change_integration_level = core
			rename_location = oe_loc_chalybopolis
		}
	}
	# 4. SET_CAPITAL_FIRST: promote chosen Chesapeake capital to city and move capital BEFORE Old World handover!
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:oe_ely_capital_choice ?= 2
			owns = location:nansemond
		}
		location:nansemond = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_city = yes } }
				change_location_rank = location_rank:city
			}
			add_location_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_ely_natural_anchorage_mod
				years = -1
				mode = replace
			}
		}
		set_capital = location:nansemond
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { owns = location:chesapeake }
		location:chesapeake = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_city = yes } }
				change_location_rank = location_rank:city
			}
			add_location_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_ely_breakwater_mod
				years = -1
				mode = replace
			}
		}
		set_capital = location:chesapeake
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { owns = location:nansemond }
		location:nansemond = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_city = yes } }
				change_location_rank = location_rank:city
			}
			add_location_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_ely_natural_anchorage_mod
				years = -1
				mode = replace
			}
		}
		set_capital = location:nansemond
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { owns = location:kiskiack }
		location:kiskiack = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_city = yes } }
				change_location_rank = location_rank:city
			}
		}
		set_capital = location:kiskiack
	}
	# 5. Seed Greek 6-estate pops & found native New Constantinople market center.
	oe_ely_seed_chesapeake_pops = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = capital
			capital = {
				continent = continent:america
				has_owner = yes
				owner = scope:oe_ely_host
				NOT = { is_market_center = yes }
			}
		}
		capital = { save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_mkt_loc }
		create_market = {
			builder = scope:oe_ely_host
			location = scope:oe_ely_mkt_loc
			price = price:oe_ely_free_market_price
			instant = yes
			price_modifier = 0
		}
	}
	# 6. Activate v9.9 Colonization 2.0 Nova Elysia Foederati hook.
	oe_col2_activate_elysia_hook = yes
	# 7. Safely detach Old World holdings, disband stranded Old World armies/navies & clear stale Old World cabinet/loans.
	oe_ely_abandon_old_world = yes
	oe_ely_cleanup_old_world_units = yes
	# 7b. Bootstrap Age 1 Chesapeake market infrastructure & spawn Nova Elysia Founding Fleet + Imperial Guard in Chesapeake.
	oe_ely_build_founding_infra = yes
	oe_ely_spawn_founding_forces = yes
	# 8. Dynamic Country Name & Act I -> Act II State Transition.
	change_country_name = OE_NOVA_ELYSIA
	change_country_adjective = OE_NOVA_ELYSIA_ADJ
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_ely_settled value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_ely_settled_year value = current_year }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_ely_settled_month value = oe_ml_month_now }
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_is_elysia value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_is_nova_elysia value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_landfall_v2_done value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_ely_voyage_stage value = 6 }
	# Cleanly close Old World oe_l7 siege & Aegean exile guerrilla chains on this host after settling in America.
	set_variable = { name = oe_l7_off value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = oe_l7_ex_reborn value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_ely_voyager }
		remove_variable = oe_ely_voyager
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ely_exodus_fleet_mod }
		remove_country_modifier = oe_ely_exodus_fleet_mod
	}
	oe_ely_grant_founding_package = yes
	# 9. Schedule post-landfall Act I closing milestones (First Winter +6m, Elysian Charter +12m).
	trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_ely.14 days = 180 }
	trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_ely.15 days = 365 }
}

# Country scope. v11.8.2 P3 Shell-Swap Setup (called from oe_ely.130 BEFORE change_player).
# Spawns tag = ELR from an Old-World-blind Eastern North American seed so Europe/Asia/Africa are 100% black fog,
# copies all researched advances, institutions & state vars, builds Chesapeake infra & fleet/guard, and saves
# scope:oe_ely_new_realm so oe_ely.130 executes change_player + oe_ely_dissolve_old_host (which transfers the dynasty once old host is AI).
oe_ely_complete_landfall_setup = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_old_host
	# 1. Record Bermuda ownership & deduct departing Greek emigrants from Old World cities.
	if = {
		limit = { owns = location:bermuda }
		set_variable = { name = oe_ely_had_bermuda value = 1 }
	}
	oe_ely_deduct_old_world_pops = yes
	# 2. Find an Old-World-blind Eastern North American landed AI seed (Priority 1: Northeast East Coast; Priority 2: any America).
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = c:ONO
			c:ONO = {
				is_ai = yes
				country_type = location
				NOT = { has_discovered = location:constantinople }
				NOT = { has_discovered = location:paris }
			}
		}
		c:ONO = { save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_amer_seed }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = c:KKA
			c:KKA = {
				is_ai = yes
				country_type = location
				NOT = { has_discovered = location:constantinople }
				NOT = { has_discovered = location:paris }
			}
		}
		c:KKA = { save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_amer_seed }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = c:ONY
			c:ONY = {
				is_ai = yes
				country_type = location
				NOT = { has_discovered = location:constantinople }
				NOT = { has_discovered = location:paris }
			}
		}
		c:ONY = { save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_amer_seed }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = c:ONN
			c:ONN = {
				is_ai = yes
				country_type = location
				NOT = { has_discovered = location:constantinople }
				NOT = { has_discovered = location:paris }
			}
		}
		c:ONN = { save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_amer_seed }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = c:GYO
			c:GYO = {
				is_ai = yes
				country_type = location
				NOT = { has_discovered = location:constantinople }
				NOT = { has_discovered = location:paris }
			}
		}
		c:GYO = { save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_amer_seed }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = c:CHK
			c:CHK = {
				is_ai = yes
				country_type = location
				NOT = { has_discovered = location:constantinople }
				NOT = { has_discovered = location:paris }
			}
		}
		c:CHK = { save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_amer_seed }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			any_country = {
				country_type = location
				is_ai = yes
				exists = capital
				capital = { continent = continent:america }
				NOT = { has_discovered = location:constantinople }
				NOT = { has_discovered = location:paris }
			}
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				country_type = location
				is_ai = yes
				exists = capital
				capital = { continent = continent:america }
				NOT = { has_discovered = location:constantinople }
				NOT = { has_discovered = location:paris }
			}
			save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_amer_seed
		}
	}
	# 3. Pick the claimable founding capital tile (nansemond if choice 2, else chesapeake).
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:oe_ely_capital_choice ?= 2
			location:nansemond = {
				is_ownable = yes
				OR = {
					has_owner = no
					AND = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_ai = yes } }
				}
			}
		}
		location:nansemond = { save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_cap_tile }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			location:chesapeake = {
				is_ownable = yes
				OR = {
					has_owner = no
					AND = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_ai = yes } }
				}
			}
		}
		location:chesapeake = { save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_cap_tile }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			location:nansemond = {
				is_ownable = yes
				OR = {
					has_owner = no
					AND = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_ai = yes } }
				}
			}
		}
		location:nansemond = { save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_cap_tile }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			location:kiskiack = {
				is_ownable = yes
				OR = {
					has_owner = no
					AND = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_ai = yes } }
				}
			}
		}
		location:kiskiack = { save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_cap_tile }
	}
	# 4. Temporarily hand ONLY the founding capital tile to oe_ely_amer_seed and spawn oe_ely_new_realm (ELR).
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:oe_ely_amer_seed
			exists = scope:oe_ely_cap_tile
		}
		scope:oe_ely_cap_tile = {
			change_location_owner = scope:oe_ely_amer_seed
			create_country_from_location = {
				save_scope_as = oe_ely_new_realm
			}
		}
	}
	# 5. Configure oe_ely_new_realm OUTSIDE create_country_from_location (vanilla wokou_events.txt rule).
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:oe_ely_new_realm }
		scope:oe_ely_new_realm = {
			define_unique_country_tag = ELR
			change_culture = scope:oe_ely_old_host.culture
			if = {
				limit = { scope:oe_ely_old_host = { exists = religion } }
				change_religion = scope:oe_ely_old_host.religion
			}
			else = {
				change_religion = religion:orthodox
			}
			change_government_type = government_type:monarchy
			change_heir_selection = heir_selection:cognatic_primogeniture
			set_country_rank = country_rank:rank_empire
			change_country_name = OE_NOVA_ELYSIA
			change_country_adjective = OE_NOVA_ELYSIA_ADJ
			change_country_color = map_BYZ
			change_country_flag = ELR
			# Copy all researched advances from old host (vanilla-verified has_advance + research_advance).
			oe_ely_copy_advances = yes
			# Carry forward Act I voyage & narrative state variables.
			if = {
				limit = { scope:oe_ely_old_host = { has_variable = oe_ely_capital_choice } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_capital_choice value = scope:oe_ely_old_host.var:oe_ely_capital_choice }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_capital_choice value = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:oe_ely_old_host = { has_variable = oe_ely_ark_tier } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ark_tier value = scope:oe_ely_old_host.var:oe_ely_ark_tier }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ark_tier value = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:oe_ely_old_host = { has_variable = oe_ely_relic_score } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_relic_score value = scope:oe_ely_old_host.var:oe_ely_relic_score }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_relic_score value = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:oe_ely_old_host = { has_variable = oe_ely_relic_focus } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_relic_focus value = scope:oe_ely_old_host.var:oe_ely_relic_focus }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:oe_ely_old_host = { has_variable = oe_ely_first_contact } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_first_contact value = scope:oe_ely_old_host.var:oe_ely_first_contact }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:oe_ely_old_host = { has_variable = oe_ely_native_goodwill } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_native_goodwill value = scope:oe_ely_old_host.var:oe_ely_native_goodwill }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:oe_ely_old_host = { has_variable = oe_ely_senate_oath } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_senate_oath value = scope:oe_ely_old_host.var:oe_ely_senate_oath }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:oe_ely_old_host = { has_variable = oe_ely_fleet_morale } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_fleet_morale value = scope:oe_ely_old_host.var:oe_ely_fleet_morale }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:oe_ely_old_host = { has_variable = oe_ely_provisions } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_provisions value = scope:oe_ely_old_host.var:oe_ely_provisions }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:oe_ely_old_host = { tag = BYZ } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_origin_tag value = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:oe_ely_old_host = { tag = TRE } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_origin_tag value = 2 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:oe_ely_old_host = { tag = FEO } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_origin_tag value = 3 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_1_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_2_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_3_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_4_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_5_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_6_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_7_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_8_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_9_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_10_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_11_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_12_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_13_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_ely_is_elysia value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_ely_is_nova_elysia value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_ely_landfall_v2_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_ely_voyage_stage value = 6 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_ely_shell_swapped value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_ely_old_world_code value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_ely_old_world_ceded_n value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_l7_off value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_l7_ex_reborn value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_scn_day1_dispatched value = 1 }
			# Claim all 3 Chesapeake bridgehead locations + classical Greek-Roman renames + cores.
			location:chesapeake = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_ownable = yes
						OR = {
							has_owner = no
							AND = {
								has_owner = yes
								owner = {
									is_ai = yes
									NOT = { this = scope:oe_ely_new_realm }
								}
							}
						}
					}
					change_location_owner = scope:oe_ely_new_realm
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_ely_new_realm }
					add_core = scope:oe_ely_new_realm
					change_integration_level = core
					rename_location = oe_loc_nea_konstantinoupolis
				}
			}
			location:nansemond = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_ownable = yes
						OR = {
							has_owner = no
							AND = {
								has_owner = yes
								owner = {
									is_ai = yes
									NOT = { this = scope:oe_ely_new_realm }
								}
							}
						}
					}
					change_location_owner = scope:oe_ely_new_realm
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_ely_new_realm }
					add_core = scope:oe_ely_new_realm
					change_integration_level = core
					rename_location = oe_loc_chrysokeras_hesperias
				}
			}
			location:kiskiack = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_ownable = yes
						OR = {
							has_owner = no
							AND = {
								has_owner = yes
								owner = {
									is_ai = yes
									NOT = { this = scope:oe_ely_new_realm }
								}
							}
						}
					}
					change_location_owner = scope:oe_ely_new_realm
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_ely_new_realm }
					add_core = scope:oe_ely_new_realm
					change_integration_level = core
					rename_location = oe_loc_chalybopolis
				}
			}
			# Carry Bermuda beacon outpost if old host claimed it in oe_ely.10 Option A.
			if = {
				limit = { scope:oe_ely_old_host = { has_variable = oe_ely_had_bermuda } }
				location:bermuda = {
					change_location_owner = scope:oe_ely_new_realm
					add_core = scope:oe_ely_new_realm
					change_integration_level = core
				}
			}
			# Promote founding capital to city, attach permanent harbor/food modifier, and set capital.
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:oe_ely_capital_choice ?= 2
					owns = location:nansemond
				}
				location:nansemond = {
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { is_city = yes } }
						change_location_rank = location_rank:city
					}
					add_location_modifier = {
						modifier = oe_ely_natural_anchorage_mod
						years = -1
						mode = replace
					}
				}
				set_capital = location:nansemond
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owns = location:chesapeake }
				location:chesapeake = {
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { is_city = yes } }
						change_location_rank = location_rank:city
					}
					add_location_modifier = {
						modifier = oe_ely_breakwater_mod
						years = -1
						mode = replace
					}
				}
				set_capital = location:chesapeake
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owns = location:nansemond }
				location:nansemond = {
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { is_city = yes } }
						change_location_rank = location_rank:city
					}
					add_location_modifier = {
						modifier = oe_ely_natural_anchorage_mod
						years = -1
						mode = replace
					}
				}
				set_capital = location:nansemond
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owns = location:kiskiack }
				location:kiskiack = {
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { is_city = yes } }
						change_location_rank = location_rank:city
					}
				}
				set_capital = location:kiskiack
			}
			# Seed 6-estate Greek pops (scaled by carried oe_ely_ark_tier & oe_ely_relic_score) & create native market.
			oe_ely_seed_chesapeake_pops = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = capital
					capital = {
						continent = continent:america
						has_owner = yes
						owner = scope:oe_ely_new_realm
						NOT = { is_market_center = yes }
					}
				}
				capital = { save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_mkt_loc }
				create_market = {
					builder = scope:oe_ely_new_realm
					location = scope:oe_ely_mkt_loc
					price = price:oe_ely_free_market_price
					instant = yes
					price_modifier = 0
				}
			}
			# Copy 100% progress of all embraced institutions from old host to every owned location of ELR,
			# and grant 6-month zero-cost embrace charter so player can embrace on Day 1 without waiting.
			scope:oe_ely_old_host = {
				every_institutions_embraced = {
					save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_inst
					scope:oe_ely_new_realm = {
						every_owned_location = {
							change_institution_progress = {
								type = scope:oe_ely_inst
								value = 100
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_ely_instant_embrace_mod
				months = 6
				mode = replace
			}
			# Discover Bermuda + all 14 East Coast areas ONLY (Europe/Asia/Africa stay 100% black fog!).
			oe_ely_discover_bermuda_only = yes
			oe_ely_discover_chesapeake_coast = yes
			# Activate Colonization 2.0 hook & replay first-contact opinion with Nansemond (NSM).
			oe_col2_activate_elysia_hook = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:oe_ely_first_contact ?= 1
					country_exists = c:NSM
					c:NSM = { country_type = pop }
				}
				c:NSM = {
					add_opinion = {
						modifier = opinion_diplomatic_gifts
						target = scope:oe_ely_new_realm
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					var:oe_ely_first_contact ?= 2
					country_exists = c:NSM
					c:NSM = { country_type = pop }
				}
				c:NSM = {
					add_opinion = {
						modifier = opinion_insulted
						target = scope:oe_ely_new_realm
					}
				}
			}
			# Bootstrap Age 1 Chesapeake infra (+500 province food, nansemond fish RGO +2), founding fleet/guard, & package.
			oe_ely_build_founding_infra = yes
			oe_ely_spawn_founding_forces = yes
			oe_ely_grant_founding_package = yes
			if = {
				limit = { legitimacy < 60 }
				add_legitimacy = 40
			}
			# Schedule post-landfall Act I closing milestones (First Winter +6m, Elysian Charter +12m) on ELR.
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_ely.14 days = 180 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_ely.15 days = 365 }
		}
		# 6. Mark global settlement & disarm Old World oe_l7 hooks on old host BEFORE player switch & dissolution.
		#    (Ruler/heir/court transfer + republic switch run at the top of oe_ely_dissolve_old_host AFTER change_player,
		#     so old BYZ/TRE/FEO is already AI and produces 0 PU toasts and 0 republic/caretaker-regency popups.)
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_ely_settled value = 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_ely_settled_year value = current_year }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_ely_settled_month value = oe_ml_month_now }
		set_variable = { name = oe_l7_off value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_l7_ex_reborn value = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_ely_had_bermuda }
			remove_variable = oe_ely_had_bermuda
		}
	}
	else = {
		# Ultra-late fallback when no Old-World-blind American country exists.
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_ely_had_bermuda }
			remove_variable = oe_ely_had_bermuda
		}
		oe_ely_complete_landfall_in_place = yes
	}
}

# Country scope (old host, now AI). Called from oe_ely.130 IMMEDIATELY AFTER change_player = scope:oe_ely_new_realm.
# Transfers imperial ruler/heir/court while old host is ALREADY AI (0 republic/regency popups & 0 PU toasts),
# then cleanly severs subjects/wars, destroys all old units, stops cabinets, and cedes EVERY Old World location so old BYZ/TRE/FEO vanishes (0 locations).
oe_ely_dissolve_old_host = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_old_host
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:oe_ely_new_realm
			NOT = { this = scope:oe_ely_new_realm }
			scope:oe_ely_new_realm = {
				has_variable = oe_ely_shell_swapped
				any_owned_location = { continent = continent:america }
			}
		}
		# 0. Clean Ruler, Heir & Court Transfer (old host is ALREADY AI -> 0 republic/regency popups & 0 Personal Union toasts!).
		if = {
			limit = { has_ruler = yes }
			ruler = { save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_exile_ruler }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_heir = yes }
			heir = { save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_exile_heir }
		}
		# Convert the soon-to-be-dissolved AI old host to republic BEFORE transferring heir/ruler so EU5 never forms/weakens/dissolves a Personal Union!
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { government_type = government_type:republic } }
			change_government_type = government_type:republic
		}
		ordered_character = {
			limit = {
				is_alive = yes
				is_adult = yes
				is_ruler = no
			}
			order_by = age_in_days
			max = 6
			check_range_bounds = no
			move_country = scope:oe_ely_new_realm
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:oe_ely_exile_ruler }
			scope:oe_ely_exile_ruler = {
				every_child = {
					limit = {
						is_alive = yes
						is_ruler = no
					}
					move_country = scope:oe_ely_new_realm
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:oe_ely_exile_heir }
			scope:oe_ely_exile_heir = {
				every_ruling_countries = {
					scope:oe_ely_exile_heir = { remove_ruler = prev }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { is_alive = yes }
					move_country = scope:oe_ely_new_realm
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:oe_ely_exile_ruler }
			scope:oe_ely_exile_ruler = {
				every_ruling_countries = {
					scope:oe_ely_exile_ruler = { remove_ruler = prev }
				}
				move_country = scope:oe_ely_new_realm
			}
			scope:oe_ely_new_realm = {
				set_new_ruler = scope:oe_ely_exile_ruler
				if = {
					limit = { exists = religion }
					change_religion_for_ruler_and_family = {
						country = scope:oe_ely_new_realm
						religion = scope:oe_ely_new_realm.religion
					}
				}
			}
		}
		# 1. Sever Old World subjects cleanly.
		every_subject = {
			save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_old_sub
			scope:oe_ely_old_host = {
				cancel_subject = scope:oe_ely_old_sub
			}
		}
		# 2. White-peace or leave all active Old World wars.
		every_current_war = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						attacker_leader = scope:oe_ely_old_host
						defender_leader = scope:oe_ely_old_host
					}
				}
				white_peace = this
			}
			else = {
				save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_w
				scope:oe_ely_old_host = {
					leave_war = {
						war = scope:oe_ely_w
						actor = scope:oe_ely_old_host
					}
				}
			}
		}
		# 3. Destroy all remaining units, stop cabinet actions & stop Phoenix bandit spawns.
		every_unit = {
			destroy_unit = yes
		}
		every_cabinet = {
			stop_cabinet_action = {}
		}
		oe_phoenix_auto_bandit_stop = yes
		# 4. Cede EVERY remaining Old World location (NO num_locations > 1 brake!) so old host drops to 0 locations and ceases to exist.
		every_owned_location = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = c:TUR
					c:TUR = { is_ai = yes }
					OR = {
						region = region:balkan_region
						region = region:anatolia_region
					}
				}
				change_location_owner = c:TUR
				scope:oe_ely_new_realm = { change_variable = { name = oe_ely_old_world_ceded_n add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					any_neighbor_location = {
						has_owner = yes
						owner = {
							is_ai = yes
							country_type = location
							NOT = { this = scope:oe_ely_old_host }
							NOT = { this = scope:oe_ely_new_realm }
						}
					}
				}
				random_neighbor_location = {
					limit = {
						has_owner = yes
						owner = {
							is_ai = yes
							country_type = location
							NOT = { this = scope:oe_ely_old_host }
							NOT = { this = scope:oe_ely_new_realm }
						}
					}
					owner = { save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_heir }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { exists = scope:oe_ely_heir }
					change_location_owner = scope:oe_ely_heir
					scope:oe_ely_new_realm = { change_variable = { name = oe_ely_old_world_ceded_n add = 1 } }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = c:TUR
					c:TUR = { is_ai = yes }
				}
				change_location_owner = c:TUR
				scope:oe_ely_new_realm = { change_variable = { name = oe_ely_old_world_ceded_n add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					any_country = {
						is_ai = yes
						country_type = location
						exists = capital
						capital = { NOT = { continent = continent:america } }
						NOT = { this = scope:oe_ely_old_host }
						NOT = { this = scope:oe_ely_new_realm }
					}
				}
				random_country = {
					limit = {
						is_ai = yes
						country_type = location
						exists = capital
						capital = { NOT = { continent = continent:america } }
						NOT = { this = scope:oe_ely_old_host }
						NOT = { this = scope:oe_ely_new_realm }
					}
					save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ely_ow_fallback
				}
				if = {
					limit = { exists = scope:oe_ely_ow_fallback }
					change_location_owner = scope:oe_ely_ow_fallback
					scope:oe_ely_new_realm = { change_variable = { name = oe_ely_old_world_ceded_n add = 1 } }
				}
			}
			else = {
				scope:oe_ely_old_host = {
					abandon_location = prev
				}
				scope:oe_ely_new_realm = {
					change_variable = { name = oe_ely_old_world_ceded_n add = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_old_world_code value = 2 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:oe_ely_new_realm }
		clear_saved_scope = oe_ely_new_realm
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Slot 72 Monthly Dispatcher (called by oe_mainline_lock or oe_ely_fallback_pulse)
# ==============================================================================

oe_ely_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { oe_ely_rule_is_off = yes }
			is_ai = no
			is_rebel_country = no
			NOT = { var:oe_ely_ran_m ?= oe_ml_month_now }
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_aborted }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ran_m value = oe_ml_month_now }

		# Phase A: Opening Triggers (Immediate 1337 or Exile-Only Crisis)
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_odyssey_launched }
				NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_declined }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					oe_ely_immediate_1337_ready = yes
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_ev_2_done }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_2_done value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.2
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					oe_ely_rule_is_exile_only = yes
					oe_ely_old_world_crisis = yes
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_ev_1_done }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_1_done value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.1
			}
		}

		# Phase B: Active Crossing Sequence (paced cleanly >= 2 months between legs)
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				oe_ely_is_voyaging = yes
				oe_ely_since_last_ev >= 2
			}
			# Stage 1: Fleet preparation (.3 -> .4 -> .5)
			if = {
				limit = { var:oe_ely_voyage_stage ?= 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_ev_3_done } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_3_done value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_last_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.3
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_ev_4_done } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_4_done value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_last_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.4
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_ev_5_done } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_5_done value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_last_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.5
				}
			}
			# Stage 2: Strait of Gibraltar (.6)
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					var:oe_ely_voyage_stage ?= 2
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_ev_6_done }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_6_done value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_last_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.6
			}
			# Stage 3: Isles of the Hesperides — Azores, Madeira, Canaries (.7)
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					var:oe_ely_voyage_stage ?= 3
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_ev_7_done }
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_7_done value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_last_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.7
			}
			# Stage 4: Sargasso Tempest (.8), optional Mutiny (.9), Bermuda Beacon (.10)
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:oe_ely_voyage_stage ?= 4 }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_ev_8_done } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_8_done value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_last_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.8
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_ev_9_done }
						OR = {
							AND = {
								has_variable = oe_ely_fleet_morale
								var:oe_ely_fleet_morale < 35
							}
							AND = {
								has_variable = oe_ely_provisions
								var:oe_ely_provisions < 30
							}
						}
					}
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_9_done value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_last_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.9
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_ev_10_done } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_10_done value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_last_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.10
				}
			}
			# Stage 5: Chesapeake Sighting (.11), First Contact (.12), Foundation (.13)
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:oe_ely_voyage_stage ?= 5 }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_ev_11_done } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_11_done value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_last_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.11
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_ev_12_done } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_12_done value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_last_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.12
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_ev_13_done } }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_13_done value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = oe_ely_last_ev_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.13
				}
			}
		}

		# Phase C: Post-Settlement Backup Safety Net & One-Time v11.8.1 Save-Healing Catch-Up
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled
				oe_ely_is_elysian_host = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_landfall_v2_done } }
				oe_ely_apply_landfall_v2_catchup = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_charter_proclaimed }
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_ev_14_done }
					oe_ely_months_since_settled >= 7
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_14_done value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.14
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_charter_proclaimed }
					has_variable = oe_ely_ev_14_done
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_ev_15_done }
					oe_ely_months_since_settled >= 13
				}
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_15_done value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ely.15
			}
		}
	}
}
